stem.en:
The museum's newest exhibit—a collection of hand-painted tiles, some of them more than a century ______ has drawn visitors from across the region.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The description of the exhibit opens with a dash, so it must close with a dash. A comma cannot close a dash pair.
why.uz: Koʻrgazma haqidagi izoh tire bilan ochilgan, shuning uchun u tire bilan yopilishi kerak. Vergul tire juftini yopa olmaydi.
why.ru: Пояснение о выставке открыто тире, поэтому закрыться оно тоже должно тире. Запятая не может закрыть пару тире.

stem.en:
Many of the town's buildings combine old and new ______ the central post office, for example, pairs a brick front from the nineteenth century with a glass roof added only recently.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Both parts are complete sentences, so a semicolon joins them. A comma makes a comma splice, and 'which' breaks the second sentence.
why.uz: Ikkala qism ham toʻliq gap, ularni nuqtali vergul bogʻlaydi. Vergul comma splice hosil qiladi, «which» esa ikkinchi gapni buzadi.
why.ru: Обе части — полные предложения, их соединяет точка с запятой. Запятая даст comma splice, а «which» ломает второе предложение.

stem.en:
The decision to replace the school's old wooden desks with lighter tables that can be rearranged for group ______ been welcomed by most teachers.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Everything before 'has' is one long subject. No punctuation may separate a subject from its verb, however long the subject is.
why.uz: «has» gacha boʻlgan hamma qism bitta uzun ega. Ega qanchalik uzun boʻlmasin, uni kesimdan tinish belgisi bilan ajratib boʻlmaydi.
why.ru: Всё до «has» — одно длинное подлежащее. Подлежащее нельзя отделять от сказуемого знаками препинания, каким бы длинным оно ни было.

stem.en:
The committee had planned to announce the winners on Friday. The judges, ______ needed more time to review the final entries, so the announcement was moved to Monday.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: 'However' interrupts the clause 'The judges needed...', so it is set off by a pair of commas: one before it and one after it.
why.uz: «However» «The judges needed...» gapini boʻlib turadi, shuning uchun u juft vergul bilan ajratiladi: oldidan ham, keyin ham.
why.ru: «However» прерывает предложение «The judges needed...», поэтому выделяется парой запятых: до и после.

stem.en:
Shahnoza spent the whole afternoon on the hardest part of the ______ the conclusion, which had to tie together three very different arguments.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: What follows names 'the hardest part'. A colon can introduce such an explanation; a semicolon cannot, because what follows is not a full sentence.
why.uz: Keyingi qism «the hardest part» ni nomlaydi. Bunday izohni ikki nuqta kiritadi; nuqtali vergul mumkin emas, chunki keyingi qism toʻliq gap emas.
why.ru: Дальше названа «the hardest part». Такое пояснение вводит двоеточие; точка с запятой невозможна, потому что дальше не полное предложение.

stem.en:
Among the items found in the old trunk ______ a pair of embroidered slippers and a letter written in faded ink.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The subject comes after the verb: 'a pair of slippers and a letter', two things joined by 'and', so the verb is plural: 'were'.
why.uz: Ega feʼldan keyin keladi: «a pair of slippers and a letter», «and» bilan bogʻlangan ikki narsa, shuning uchun feʼl koʻplikda: «were».
why.ru: Подлежащее стоит после глагола: «a pair of slippers and a letter» — два предмета, соединённые «and», поэтому глагол во мн. ч.: «were».

stem.en:
If the volunteers had known that the road would be closed, they ______ the supplies a day earlier.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: 'If... had known' describes an unreal past condition, which pairs with 'would have' + past participle: 'would have delivered'.
why.uz: «If... had known» oʻtmishdagi real boʻlmagan shartni bildiradi, u «would have» + III shakl bilan juftlashadi: «would have delivered».
why.ru: «If... had known» — нереальное условие в прошлом, оно сочетается с «would have» + причастие: «would have delivered».

stem.en:
The new library policy allows students to borrow up to five books, to renew them online, and ______ them at any branch in the city.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The list is built from 'to' verbs ('to borrow', 'to renew'), so the last item must match: 'to return'.
why.uz: Roʻyxat «to» li feʼllardan tuzilgan («to borrow», «to renew»), shuning uchun oxirgi band ham shunday boʻlishi kerak: «to return».
why.ru: Перечень построен из глаголов с «to» («to borrow», «to renew»), поэтому последний пункт тоже: «to return».

stem.en:
The number of students who ride bicycles to school ______ risen steadily since the town added bicycle lanes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The subject is 'the number', which is singular; 'students' and 'bicycles' are inside other phrases. So the verb is 'has'.
why.uz: Ega «the number», u birlikda; «students» va «bicycles» boshqa birikmalar ichida. Shuning uchun feʼl «has».
why.ru: Подлежащее — «the number», оно в ед. ч.; «students» и «bicycles» входят в другие обороты. Поэтому глагол «has».

stem.en:
Praised by critics for its careful research and vivid characters, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: the novel quickly found a large audience among young readers.
readers quickly embraced the novel, especially young ones.
the author saw her novel quickly find a large audience.
young readers quickly made the novel a favorite.

why.en: The opening phrase describes something praised for 'its' research, so the word after the comma must be the novel itself.
why.uz: Boshlangʻich ibora tadqiqoti uchun maqtalgan narsani tasvirlaydi («its»), shuning uchun verguldan keyin roman oʻzi kelishi kerak.
why.ru: Начальный оборот описывает то, что хвалят за «its» research, поэтому сразу после запятой должен стоять сам роман.

stem.en:
Sanjar wanted to buy a new bicycle, but he did not have enough money. ______ he started walking his neighbors' dogs after school to earn the rest.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: Walking dogs is the result of not having enough money, so a cause-and-effect word, 'Therefore', fits.
why.uz: Itlarni sayr qildirish pul yetmasligining natijasi, shuning uchun sabab-natija soʻzi «Therefore» mos keladi.
why.ru: Выгул собак — следствие нехватки денег, поэтому подходит слово причины и следствия «Therefore».

stem.en:
Most of the plants in Lola's garden need water every day. Her cactus, ______ can go for weeks without being watered.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The cactus is the opposite of the other plants (weeks without water versus every day), so a contrast word, 'however', fits.
why.uz: Kaktus boshqa oʻsimliklarning aksi (har kuni emas, haftalab suvsiz), shuning uchun qarama-qarshilik soʻzi «however» mos.
why.ru: Кактус — противоположность другим растениям (неделями без воды, а не каждый день), поэтому подходит слово контраста «however».

The school play had been planned for months. Then, two days before the show, the lead actor caught a bad cold. ______ his understudy, who had practiced every line, stepped in and performed the role.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: After a problem (the actor is sick) comes a lucky solution (a prepared replacement), so 'Fortunately' fits.
why.uz: Muammodan (aktyor kasal) keyin omadli yechim keladi (tayyor zaxira aktyor), shuning uchun «Fortunately» mos.
why.ru: После проблемы (актёр заболел) идёт удачное решение (подготовленный дублёр), поэтому подходит «Fortunately».

why.ru: Текст переходит от первой недели к гораздо более позднему моменту, поэтому подходит слово времени «Eventually».

why.ru: Второе предложение добавляет ещё одну услугу центра, поэтому подходит слово добавления «Additionally».

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Oqtepa School book fair will take place on 14 November.
• It will be held in the school gym.
• Students can buy new books or trade their used books.
• Money raised will buy new books for the school library.

The student wants to tell students when and where the book fair will take place.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: The book fair will be held in the school gym on 14 November.
At the book fair, students can buy new books or trade used ones.
Money raised at the fair will buy new books for the school library.
The school is holding a book fair that will help its library grow.

why.en: The goal is 'when and where'; only the first choice gives both the place (the gym) and the date (14 November).
why.uz: Maqsad «qachon va qayerda»; faqat birinchi javob ham joyni (sport zali), ham sanani (14-noyabr) beradi.
why.ru: Цель — «когда и где»; только первый ответ называет и место (спортзал), и дату (14 ноября).

instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Ibn Sina was born around 980 in Afshana, a village near Bukhara.
• He wrote The Canon of Medicine.
• The Canon is a medical encyclopedia in five volumes.
• For centuries it was a standard medical textbook in the Islamic world and in Europe.

The student wants to emphasize how long The Canon of Medicine remained in use.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: For centuries, Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine was a standard medical textbook in the Islamic world and in Europe.
Ibn Sina, who wrote The Canon of Medicine, a medical encyclopedia in five volumes, was born around 980 in Afshana.
The Canon of Medicine is a medical encyclopedia in five volumes.
Ibn Sina was born near Bukhara and later wrote about medicine.

why.en: The goal is how long the book was used. Only the choice with "for centuries" gives that span; the others give the author's birth or the book's size.
why.uz: Maqsad — kitob qancha vaqt ishlatilganini koʻrsatish. Bu muddatni faqat «for centuries» soʻzlari bor javob beradi; qolganlari muallifning tugʻilishi yoki kitob hajmi haqida.
why.ru: Цель — показать, как долго использовалась книга. Этот срок даёт только вариант с «for centuries»; остальные — о рождении автора или объёме книги.

instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• In April, Malika's class planted 30 trees along the river.
• A local plant nursery gave the trees to the class.
• Students watered the trees every weekend during the summer.
• By October, 28 of the 30 trees were still growing.

The student wants to present the result of the class's tree-planting project.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: By October, 28 of the 30 trees the class had planted were still growing.
In April, Malika's class planted 30 trees along the river.
A local plant nursery gave the class all of the trees that it planted by the river.
Every weekend during the summer, students watered the trees.

why.en: A result is what happened in the end; only the first choice reports the outcome: 28 of 30 trees still growing in October.
why.uz: Natija oxirida nima boʻlgani; faqat birinchi javob yakunni aytadi: oktyabrda 30 daraxtdan 28 tasi oʻsib turgan.
why.ru: Результат — то, что получилось в итоге; только первый ответ сообщает исход: в октябре росли 28 деревьев из 30.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Venus is a planet in our solar system.
• It spins in the opposite direction from most planets, including Earth.
• One full spin of Venus takes about 243 Earth days.
• One orbit of Venus around the Sun takes about 225 Earth days.

The student wants to compare the length of one spin of Venus with the length of its year.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: One spin of Venus takes about 243 Earth days, longer than its year of about 225 Earth days.
Venus spins in the opposite direction from most planets, including Earth.
Venus is a planet in our solar system that travels around the Sun.
One orbit of Venus around the Sun takes about 225 Earth days.

why.en: A comparison needs both lengths. Only the first choice gives the spin (243 days) and the year (225 days) and relates them.
why.uz: Solishtirish uchun ikkala davomiylik kerak. Faqat birinchi javob aylanishni (243 kun) va yilni (225 kun) berib, ularni taqqoslaydi.
why.ru: Для сравнения нужны обе величины. Только первый ответ даёт и оборот (243 дня), и год (225 дней) и сопоставляет их.

instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Jasur's family keeps bees in their village.
• The family has twelve hives.
• In a good year, the hives give honey for the family and for sale at the market.
• Jasur helps his father check the hives every Sunday.

The student wants to explain Jasur's role in his family's beekeeping.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Every Sunday, Jasur helps his father check the family's beehives.
Jasur's family keeps twelve beehives in their village.
The family sells some of its honey at the village market.
In a good year, the family's twelve hives give plenty of honey to eat and to sell.

why.en: The goal is Jasur's own role; only the first choice says what Jasur does: he checks the hives with his father every Sunday.
why.uz: Maqsad Jasurning oʻz vazifasi; faqat birinchi javob Jasur nima qilishini aytadi: har yakshanba otasi bilan uyalarni tekshiradi.
why.ru: Цель — роль самого Жасура; только первый ответ говорит, что он делает: каждое воскресенье проверяет ульи с отцом.
